newsitem.title: USA: U.S. electronics exports up - trade group.
newsitem.headline: U.S. electronics exports up - trade group.

text.p: The Electronic Industries Association said Tuesday that U.S. exports of electronics products rose to nearly $65 billion during the first six months of this year.
The trade group said the increase represented growth of 11 percent from 1995's first-half total of $58.3 billion.
The most substantial gains in U.S. exports were made in the passive components sector, with exports up 19 percent, and in the computers and peripherals area, with an increase of 18 percent.

Imports of foreign electronics products for the first half of 1996 reached $76 billion, up 10 percent, from $69.2 billion in the first six months of 1995. The association compiled the data from Department of Commerce figures.
